## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves

Describe the problem this feature would solve. For example:
- "I'm currently tracking detection reasoning manually and it..."
- "When I catalog rules, I often need to..."
- "It's difficult to..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. Include:
- CLI command syntax if applicable: `adef detection <new-command>`
- Expected output or behavior
- Any configuration options needed

## Alternative Solutions

Have you considered alternative approaches? Describe them here.

## Scope Check

ADEF has deliberate anti-goals (CLI + MCP only for v0.1.0; four engine types;
never writes upstream rule YAML; no vendor API connectors). Does this fit
within those, or does it require changing one? See `docs/roadmap.md`.

## Impact

Who would benefit from this feature?
- [ ] Solo detection engineers
- [ ] Small teams (2-5 people)
- [ ] Enterprise detection teams
- [ ] Threat hunters (ATHF users)
- [ ] All users

## Willingness to Contribute

- [ ] I'm willing to submit a PR for this feature
- [ ] I need guidance on how to implement this
- [ ] I'm just suggesting, not implementing

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples here.
